text:
morgan_support: seeing a burst of 502s from the hosted API for tenant=acme-inc after the migration at 10:12 UTC. ~20% of requests hitting /v1/generate return 502 quickly. sample trace id: trace-afe12c

devon_sre: thanks — can you paste a curl repro and one full request/response trace id? also which frontend (ingress/nginx/envoy) path?

morgan_support: repro curl: `curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"X-Tenant: acme-inc\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d \"{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}\"` 
response snippet: `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream reset"}`
this appears on both us-east and eu-west frontends.

jamie.ops: deploy-bot shows a canary deploy for the tenant migration finished at 10:10 UTC, but we pushed routing rule changes at 10:11. tagging @anika_prod to confirm. :thinking_face:

anika_prod: I rolled the tenant routing map forward for acme-inc at 10:11, yes. We did a weight shift to the new hotpath variant and enabled cold-cache warming. nothing else changed.

devon_sre: hypothesis: hotpath variant has a missing header or smaller buffer causing envoy to reset on big requests. can we get one full tcp dump / envoy logs for a failing request? trace id trace-afe12c shows upstream connect failure 504/502 around conn reset in envoy.

morgan_support: attaching small extract from envoy access log (copied): `ts=2025-06-02T10:12:31Z method=POST path=/v1/generate resp_code=502 upstream_host=10.12.5.33:8080 up_status=503 up_tx=0 up_rx=512 latency_ms=23 trace=trace-afe12c`

devon_sre: ok that up_tx=0 + low latency points to immediate upstream refusal. try repro with a smaller payload and with `Connection: keep-alive` vs `close`. can you run both?

morgan_support: ran quick test — small payload succeeds, large payload (~1.2MB prompt bundle) fails consistently. keep-alive vs close no change.

jamie.ops: sounds like upstream rejects large payloads when hitting hotpath variant (maybe buffer or rate limiter). rolling routing back to 100% old variant for acme-inc now. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: rollback executed: routing acme-inc -> canonical-variant-v2 (old) at 2025-06-02T10:14:02Z by jamie.ops (changeset cs-9987).

anika_prod: keep the rollback for 15m while we collect logs. can we also enable an ingress buffer increase and temporarily bypass the rate limiter for the tenant while we investigate?

devon_sre: quick mitigation: bump envoy `max_request_bytes` and upstream buffer to 2.5MB in the ingress config for the affected pool and disable the tenant-specific payload throttling rule. will apply in ~2m.

morgan_support: after rollback + buffer bump I see success rate back to 99% for acme-inc. no more 502s in the last 3 minutes. thanks.

devon_sre: root cause likely a config mismatch in the new hotpath variant — missing upstream header that triggers a fast reject in the model backend for large inputs. follow-ups: 1) audit hotpath nginx/envoy config for request size and header plumbing, 2) reproduce with synthetic large payloads in staging, 3) add a canary metric for large-payload rejects, 4) add automated rollback if 502 rate > 2% for 2m.

jamie.ops: noted. I'll open a tracking ticket and assign to runtime-team and eng-ml for the variant checkout. ticket: RW-5043.

morgan_support: attaching steps to reproduce for support playbook:
1) set X-Tenant: acme-inc
2) POST /v1/generate with body size > 1MB
3) observe `HTTP/1.1 502` and envoy access log up_tx=0 up_rx>0
4) collect trace id from response header `x-rw-trace`

anika_prod: thanks — good recovery. leaving rollback for 30m then gradual re-roll after fix. :rocket:
